canonical_definition:
What it is. The available description treats ASAP as the Hewlett Foundation Short Answer Scoring dataset, containing short essay responses across science and biology topics for evaluating automated scoring systems. The description does not mention versions or subsets.

What it is claimed to measure. The available paper describes ASAP as a dataset used for evaluating automated scoring systems, but papers do not link it to any named constructs or behavioral indicators.

Space of uses. No other measurement instruments are linked to ASAP. The available paper presents it as a dataset of short essay responses on science and biology topics for evaluating automated scoring systems.
